name: Chaos Queen Ryouko Story #1 Ninomiya Mii Hen
original_name: カオスQUEEN遼子 STORY#1 二宮美依編
source:
Ryouko always bullied her sister Misuzu, but now Misuzu got married and Ryouko has become the counselor of love problems to bully a much wider range of pretty girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
辽子过去总是欺负妹妹美铃，如今美铃已经结婚，辽子则摇身一变成为恋爱问题顾问，以便把欺负对象扩展到更多漂亮女孩身上。
